ValidationRule.description: Requires Primary Campaign Source, Type, Primary Module, Lead Source and Lead Type to be populated when the Opportunity Stage is Demo Booked. Honors the On/Off Switch (Run Validation Rules).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.On_Off_Switch__c.Run_Validation_Rules__c && ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Demo Booked") && ( ISBLANK(CampaignId) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Type)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Module__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Lead_Type__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving the Opportunity to Demo Booked, please complete the following fields: Primary Campaign Source, Type, Primary Module, Lead Source and Lead Type.
